paper.citation: Nie, X. and Wager, S. (2021). Quasi-oracle estimation of heterogeneous treatment effects. Biometrika 108(2), 299-319. DOI: 10.1093/biomet/asaa076.
paper.source_locator: Section 6.1, arXiv:1712.04912v4 (6 Aug 2020) PDF p.16, unnumbered Setup C paragraph (no equation number in the source): 'e*(Xi) = 1/(1 + e^{Xi2+Xi3}), b*(Xi) = 2 log(1 + e^{Xi1+Xi2+Xi3}), and the treatment effect is constant, tau*(Xi) = 1'.

mechanism.name: Nie–Wager (2021) Setup C: constant effect under a logistic propensity

generation_equations.label: Outcome
generation_equations.expression: Y = b(X) + A tau(X) + sigma eps, eps ~ Normal(0,1), sigma = 1

assumptions: SUTVA: one version of treatment, no interference
Unconfoundedness: treatment depends on X2 + X3, which also enters the baseline; the design is observational
Overlap: e(x) = 1/(1+e^{x2+x3}) is strictly inside (0,1) for every finite x, but the tails are thin; no uniform bound is claimed

properties.notes: All three coordinates act, but only additively inside two smooth functions: the baseline is a softplus of X1+X2+X3 and the propensity is a logistic of X2+X3. The effect surface is constant, so this contribution carries no heterogeneity and is a control for confounding bias.

estimand.name: tau(x0) = E[Y(1) - Y(0) | X = x0]
estimand.definition: Conditional average treatment effect at the declared query points; constant equal to 1 for every x, so the whole difficulty is the strongly confounded nuisance structure.

truth.expression: Conditional average treatment effect at the declared query points; constant equal to 1 for every x, so the whole difficulty is the strongly confounded nuisance structure.
truth.derivation: Closed form: the declared surface is the constant 1, so the population CATE is exactly 1 everywhere; verified against the realised outcome column.

adaptations: Dimension fixed at d = 3, the smallest dimension for which Setup C is defined; the source varies d in {6, 12}.
The source writes Y = b(X) + (W - 0.5) tau(X) + sigma eps; this package uses A in {0,1}. The CATE is unchanged.
